resultEvidence.title: Wall-mounted cooling unit Blue e+ Dynamic 1.0 kW – 2.6 kW
resultEvidence.description: The Blue e+ Dynamic series of cooling units is designed specifically for use in dynamic applications. The devices are tested to DNV-CG-0339 and are therefore ideal for use on board ships (e.g. enclosures in the engine room). Their exceptionally stable mechanical design makes these cooling units suitable for any application that creates high vibration levels on the device, such as applications in ports (cranes), logistics (storage and retrieval systems) and airports (baggage handling systems).
